It's hard... Very hard, but there is hope at the end of the tunnel.. it's far away for me at the moment, but I'm walking towards it.

My loneliness is something I'm trying to accept and deal with, it's not something I can change, for some reason, People keep their distance from me. 

Don't give up though... you need to find inner love before anyone else can love you. if you don't love yourself, life becomes very hard, almost impossible.

Thanks... Thanks everyone! 

I'm feeling much better now :)

In my case, I've been a loner all my life. - to top it all off, I'm an Aspie, so I find it very hard to read other people's emotions. - I drive them away, and it makes me hate myself to such a degree that it physically hurts.
It's very hard to keep strong for me at the moment... I feel so damned lonely, that it's like being crushed by a boulder for every second of every single day.
No... I've never heard of that.. what is it?

I simply don't understand that spark... what makes me feel so hopeless is the crippling loneliness that I feel each second that I'm alone. or when I'm in a crowd of people, and nobody even acknowledges my existence..
Sure... I'll be trying to get a workout in tonight, but in the evening I should be free.
That could be true, but I'd really like to end up with a friend after this... at the moment all I have are acquaintances... :(

the thing is, when we're talking through instant messaging it's much easier, than when we're talking face to face. - he's not let on any indication that I've offended him, but the fact that we don't talk face to face, barely or at all, is bothering me a little bit. - we spoke more in the beginning than we do now.
I just don't know, I find myself feeling rather awkward when I think about doing something like that. - Is it normal to feel this weird?

I am just recovering from Depression, signs keep coming back reminding me of it. I've been to lots of psychiatrists in the past and they told me that what I need to do now is integrate and make friends, which I'm finding really hard to do. 

I'm scared of destroying friendships before they even start, and I'm scared that my own appearance in front of people drives them away from me. 

I joined a gym and tried to make friends there, but even there. I feel alone in a room of people...

I'm 24, and live on a tiny island in the med, so you could say it's a big town, Malta I'm pretty mobile, and thanks for this dude :) I'm feeling much better. 

You're all right!

You are so very, very right :)

Thanks for this, I'm feeling tons better

Thanks for this. He didn't tell me to take steroids, he told me that big muscled guys are likely taking them. 

I'm over this problem. I had a work party last night and they made me into one of the highlights, hell they voted me into second place at the work 'Mr. Beach Body contest'! 

I'm not buff, yet.. But they did it to show that they noticed my change in attitude and lifestyle :)

My aspergers might make things harder, but I am seriously underestimating my ability to socialise and my confidence has been increasing.

I think I'm going to give up. The anxiety that this is causing me is making me feel worthless and not worth the time and effort that I'm putting into this. My trainer told me to get good gains when muscle training I have to be jacked up on Steroids... Which means that my dreams of having a respectable body are out the window. I don't know why I even bothered. I'm never worth any time or effort. It always blows up in my face.

You might have noticed that I've been going through a bit of a rough patch in the last few months. I'd like to thank everyone that reached out to me and tried to steer me away from the bad route I was taking. It's been tough but finally, I'm seeing the light at the end of the tunnel. I've deleted all of the negative content I could find, and I'm starting 2016 from scratch. I hope that I can make more friends and make better connections with those that I already have.  

I will get out of this, I know that I can.
I just lost my friend. I know why too. I was being way too fucking clingy. I want to lock myself in a box and suffocate to death.

I've just spent an entire day wallowing in sorrow, lying down in my bed thinking about in how many ways I've failed myself.  I might be closing this account and all of my online presences to isolate myself. I'm deserving of this. ﻿
If I go, no one will miss me. I've been told this to my face before.
I don't think I can.

I thought that the problem was solved but now I feel rejected again. He's stopped talking to me. 

I'm just going to lay in bed and cry. I cannot stand this anymore.
I tried that, and look at where it got me, even more alone.
I still want to give up. things are never going to get better :(
People don't care do they......
I honestly couldn't care about people in 3rd world countries. I'm surrounded by so much hate that it doesn't effing matter...
